title: Hydro Dynamics — Where It All Began
desc: Ten fifth-graders from Swanson Elementary entered as Team #31191, built a Fitbit-inspired composting motivator for watershed health, and made it to sectionals in year one.

title: Into Orbit — First Trip to Worlds
desc: A 1st Place Research Award at Wisconsin State sent us to the FLL World Festival in Detroit — our first-ever Worlds trip — for a research project on retractable satellite solar panels.

title: Skystone — Our Rookie Journey
desc: Our FTC rookie season — one of just three FTC teams in the entire Brookfield school district — and we still reached the Wisconsin State Championship finals.

title: Ultimate Goal — Growing Through Challenge
desc: A hybrid COVID season split between remote and in-person events. We leaned into Vuforia-driven autonomous scoring and won the Control Award twice.

title: Freight Frenzy — First Worlds Qualification
desc: Our first-ever Inspire Award, a Winning Alliance Captain finish at Wisconsin State, and the program's first FTC World Championship qualification — Houston, Texas.

title: POWERPLAY — Building Roadrunner
desc: Built Roadrunner, our first fully custom-fabricated robot, adopted GE HealthCare's DHF engineering framework, and founded the Children's Hospital of Wisconsin STEM program.

title: CENTERSTAGE — 2nd at Worlds
desc: A second trip to the World Championship — Franklin Division, Houston — and a 2nd Place Inspire Award, the program's best Worlds finish at the time.

title: Into the Deep — Best Season Yet
desc: Ranked 14th in the world by OPR, hosted our first-ever Rookie Qualifier, and won the 1st Place CONNECT Award at Worlds — our first judged award on that stage.

title: DECODE — A New Generation Leads
desc: Six new student mentors took full ownership of the season: three robot iterations, $15K+ donated, and 41 Production Hub projects delivered for other teams.
